content.text: {"answer":"None of these papers is about finding evidence subgraphs from a hidden knowledge graph without training. The results instead cover authorship, writing-style drift, and style retention or homogenization in human and LLM-generated text [1-10].\n\nA few papers use graph-like data, but not for evidence-subgraph discovery: one studies academic genealogy pairs from the Mathematics Genealogy Project graph to analyze writing-style similarity [6], and others benchmark or measure authorship verification and personalization effects in text generation [2, 9, 10]. So these results do not answer the specific request for training-free evidence subgraph methods.","grounded":false}

validation_error: Grounded answers must cite papers; ungrounded answers must not
